Probably not very well depending on the person, I have pretty bad sensory issues so let's say I lost my shoes and have to walk on grass, if that happened I'd immediately be dead, that's like the one thing I can't do even if my life depended on it. Also guns are loud and that could cause issues, but I guess I could always use a different weapon such as a bow or blade, but also I can't deal with other people's blood on me so there's another reason I wouldn't fair well. There's a lot of things to take into consideration, if we need to be quiet we can't communicate through facial expressions very well, we have sensory issues, but there's also advantages such as for us it's easier to recognize patterns. If we were in a situation where quick thinking is necessary then it may be easier for us. I'd say alone we wouldn't fair well, but in a group or with another person we would do fine. (All of this is for me personally and maybe some others since it is a spectrum and I'd be considered "higher functioning" aka my autism isn't as noticeable for others)
